description_en: Queries the list of rooms under an application, including the information about each room and the atomic capabilities in use
description_zh: 调用ListRooms查询应用下的房间列表，包含每个房间的信息和正在使用的原子能力信息
name: ListRooms

parameters.description_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length.
parameters.description_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符。
parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the application. The value can contain lowercase letters and digits and is 6 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 应用唯一标识，可以包含小写字母、数字，长度为6个字符
parameters.name: app_id

parameters.description_en: The page number to query, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default.
parameters.description_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，参数为空默认查询第1页。
parameters.help_en: The page number to query, starting from 1. If this parameter is left empty, the first page is queried by default
parameters.help_zh: 查询页码，从1开始，参数为空默认查询第1页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10.
parameters.description_zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持50，参数为空默认显示个数为10。
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: 50. If this parameter is left empty, the default value is 10
parameters.help_zh: 每页显示个数，最大支持50，参数为空默认显示个数为10
parameters.name: page_size
